title: Jagged Crispy Brazilian Cheese Flatbread
description: A crispy and cozy Brazilian dish featuring cheese and a fold, with a peppery flavor, this flatbread is perfect for a snack or light meal, and is ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, parmesan cheese, and salt.
Add the melted butter, egg, black pepper, and dried oregano to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball of dough into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Fold each circle of dough in half and then in half again to form a triangle.
Place the triangles on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops of the triangles with a little bit of water and sprinkle with minced parsley.
Bake the flatbreads for 15-20 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
